# Regression test for golang.org/issue/31481.

env BOLERO_MODULE=on

# golang.org/issue/31481: an explicit flag should make directories in the module
# cache writable in order to work around the historical inability of 'rm -rf' to
# forcibly remove files in unwritable directories.
bolero get -modcacherw rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2
cp $WORK/extraneous.txt $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2/extraneous_file.go

# After adding an extraneous file, 'bolero mod verify' should fail.
! bolero mod verify

# However, files within those directories should still be read-only to avoid
# accidental mutations.
[!root] ! cp $WORK/extraneous.txt $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2/go.mod

# If all 'go' commands ran with the flag, the system's 'rm' binary
# should be able to remove the module cache if the '-rf' flags are set.
[!GOOS:windows] [exec:rm] exec rm -rf $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod
[!GOOS:windows] [!exec:rm] bolero clean -modcache
[GOOS:windows] [exec:cmd.exe] exec cmd.exe /c rmdir /s /q $BOLERO_PATH\pkg\mod
[GOOS:windows] [!exec:cmd.exe] bolero clean -modcache
! exists $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod

# The directories in the module cache should by default be unwritable,
# so that tests and tools will not accidentally add extraneous files to them.
# Windows does not respect FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY on directories, according
# to MSDN, so there we disable testing whether the directory itself is
# unwritable.
bolero get rsc.io/quote@latest
[!root] ! cp $WORK/extraneous.txt $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2/go.mod
[!GOOS:windows] [!root] ! cp $WORK/extraneous.txt $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2/extraneous_file.go
! exists $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2/extraneous_file.go


# Repeat part of the test with 'bolero mod download' instead of 'bolero get' to verify
# -modcacherw is supported on 'bolero mod' subcommands.
bolero clean -modcache
bolero mod download -modcacherw rsc.io/quote
cp $WORK/extraneous.txt $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2/extraneous_file.go
! bolero mod verify
[!root] ! cp $WORK/extraneous.txt $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2/go.mod

# Repeat part of the test with 'bolero tool'
bolero mod edit -tool example.com/tools/cmd/hello -require example.com/tools@v1.0.0
bolero mod download -modcacherw example.com/tools
bolero clean -modcache
bolero tool -modcacherw hello
cp $WORK/extraneous.txt $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/example.com/tools@v1.0.0/extraneous_file.go
! bolero mod verify
[!root] ! cp $WORK/extraneous.txt $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/example.com/tools@v1.0.0/cmd/hello/hello.go


-- $WORK/extraneous.txt --
module oops
-- go.mod --
module golang.org/issue/31481
